column1: # Norway (no.cautious, ruling R64): no national authority. Members: IRN's joint calendar (no.irn, Oslo's largest
# mosques, the most followed) and Diyanet's European method (subtask 7b's). Each member's tables where held:
# - Oslo: IRN's 2026 calendar (both Asr columns printed) and Diyanet's Oslo table (September 2026-December 2027; its
#   Fajr is also its imsak), split by year (Task 7g slices in europe/split-7g/). Maghrib is checked like every start on
#   every row below (ruling R155: the latest member's from the sun; until then the 26 Sep cap followed IRN's, the most
#   followed, and left Diyanet's rows unchecked where IRN's calendar was not held). On the winter days Diyanet's own
#   five-hour day holds its Maghrib later than the sun gives it (Trondheim), Diyanet's is checked at its Maghrib from the
#   sun and the gap to its printed one recorded: the far-north guard (ruling R156).
# - Trondheim: IRN's 2026 calendar.
# Every row is held out (a cautious entry has no margins of its own).
# - Trondheim, Diyanet (the monitor round, brief D): its own table, the member tr.diyanet.europe at its new unit there,
#   the monitor's capture of 28 Sep 2026 sliced by year (archive/tables/monitor-round/).
# - Kristiansand, Stavanger and Bergen, Diyanet (the monitor round, step c): its own tables, the member tr.diyanet.europe at
#   its units there.
# - Oslo, Diyanet (the monitor's capture of 28 Sep 2026, the member tr.diyanet.europe): 29 Sep – 29 Oct 2026 and 2027,
#   the same minutes as the split-7g rows on every day both hold; it adds 26–29 October.
# - The monitor's captures are read from copies pinned as they were (archive/tables/pinned/tr-diyanet-europe/<date>/):
#   2026-09-28 for the rows above; Oslo's capture of 2 Oct 2026 (2026-10-02/, 29 Sep – 1 Nov 2026 and 2027, the same
#   minutes on every day both hold) is a row too, as the 28 Sep row: it adds 30 Oct – 1 Nov.
